head: Can you reverse
type 2 diabetes?
name: Dr. Neal Barnard
end_cta: Find Dr. Neal Barnard on|Vegans Explore

captions.text: We decided to do something different,
and that was a diet with no animal products and keeping oils really low.
And we found that this new approach was three times better at reducing blood sugar
And it started to open the door to people with diabetes needing less medicine,
maybe no medicine at all, or maybe the disease itself actually went away.
The discovery that sugar doesn't cause diabetes.
It's caused by fatty foods putting fat particles inside your muscle and liver cells
that cause your insulin to not be able to work in those cells anymore.
Well, we get that gummy fat out of your cells by changing your diet,
